hero.tagline: Computer science student with experience in software development. I like building things, figuring out how they work, and learning along the way.

about.label: About
about.heading: A bit about me.
about.p1: I'm Lukas, a computer science student based in Ulm. <highlight>I enjoy building things</highlight>, exploring new ideas, and figuring out how things work. Often, I start a project simply because it seems interesting or because I want to try something new.
about.p2: I mostly work with TypeScript, JavaScript and Python. I'm particularly interested in <highlight>full-stack development, with a focus on frontend</highlight>, but I enjoy exploring different areas of software development.

experience.label: Experience
experience.heading: From theory to practice.
experience.desc: A look at the different stages of my journey through computer science, shaped by a mix of academic study and practical experience. From my first steps in software development to my current studies, each stage has brought new perspectives, challenges, and things to explore.

entries.title: Abitur
entries.desc: Although my Abitur is not directly related to my later career in computer science, I discovered and developed my interest in programming during my school years.

entries.title: B.Eng. Telecommunication Computer Science
entries.desc: Completed a dual-study degree combining academic coursework with practical software development at T-Systems International GmbH. Worked primarily on a large Vue frontend project as part of a larger development team.

entries.title: M.Sc. Computer Science
entries.desc: Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science at Ulm University, where I am deepening my knowledge and continuing to develop my technical skills.

contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Say hello.
contact.desc: I'm currently looking for a working student position where I can get more experience in software development and contribute to a real project. If you're looking for someone who enjoys learning, building things and getting into the details, feel free to get in touch.
